name: Bitdeer Weathersfield (Niles) development site
summary: Bitdeer development site on 41.8 owned acres at the former Niles Generating Station, demolished in 2013, in Weathersfield, Ohio, near Niles. Bitdeer launched it in September 2025 as a 300 MW grid-interconnected power pipeline under an interconnection agreement with FirstEnergy, which first scheduled energization for Q1 2029. Bitdeer's Q2 2026 results, with data as of 31 July 2026, target energization in Q4 2028, cite a transmission line extension agreement with a local utility, and list planned usage as colocation and AI cloud; the site is still described as a development site.

location.note: Bitdeer names the site Niles and later Weathersfield, Ohio, without an address. The point is the Weathersfield Township coordinate from its Wikipedia article, which lists much of the city of Niles among the township's populated places; it is not the site.

parties.name: FirstEnergy
parties.note: Party to the interconnection agreement and set the original energization schedule. The 2026 results refer only to a transmission line extension agreement with an unnamed local utility company.

metrics.note: Listed as the capacity of a grid-interconnected development site in Bitdeer's power pipeline. Bitdeer's 2025 updates footnote their capacity figures as total available electrical capacity.

milestones.note: Bitdeer said it officially launched the 300 MW Niles power pipeline in September 2025.
Target energization (ready-for-service) as of July 2026. The 2025 updates gave Q1 2029 as scheduled by FirstEnergy.

power_sources.description: Grid interconnection under an agreement with FirstEnergy, plus a transmission line extension agreement with a local utility.
